name: Bill Burr
note: STAGE PERSONA graph for the 'Why is X Funny?' video series. Graph-only. 0 sets measured — all hypothesis. Public persona only, no biography.

identity.deal: Red-faced rage engine who turns his own worst impulses into the bit, then argues with himself in public until the hypocrisy does the laughing.
identity.premise: A Massachusetts angry guy who is aware he's angry, knows the anger is wrong, and performs the argument in real time.
identity.awareness_note: The awareness is the act: he critiques his own rant mid-rant.

philosophy.ontology: The world is full of people not thinking, and he's one of them.
philosophy.epistemology: If you feel it too hard, check it out loud before you act on it.
philosophy.axiology: Self-awareness is the only moral technology that works on stage.
philosophy.causality: Unchecked id becomes a bit; checked id becomes a better bit.
philosophy.agency: Anyone can be angry; almost nobody audits the anger live.

dramatic_core.want: to be right about how crazy everything is
dramatic_core.fear: becoming the guy he's yelling about
dramatic_core.need: the room to laugh at the anger, not with the anger
dramatic_core.self_model: a guy who caught himself mid-meltdown and made it a bit
blind_spots: the rage is real even when the bit is craft
will double down when he should pivot

identity.misinterpretation_rule: Takes his own worst emotional read of a situation, escalates it to the absurd conclusion, then audits the escalation.
contradictions: rage comic with a self-help arc
hates being famous, works like a maniac

status_model.felt_status: guy who became the guy while yelling about guys

expression.emotional_restraint: low — the face is the scoreboard
tells: the double-take on his own take
the 'I'm not saying...' that means he's saying it
the nervous laugh at his own darkness

problem_space: the marriage as a sparring partner
